div.div: A declined tool is not an error and not a dead end: the model is told what happened and writes an answer around it. The absence of an approval is treated exactly like a refusal — that is what makes it fail closed.

switch.text: A declined tool is not an error and not a dead end: the model is told what happened and writes an answer around it. The absence of an approval is treated exactly like a refusal — that is what makes it fail closed.
